end.summary:
Classified melting, burning, milk spoiling, sparklers, and torn posters using evidence.
Discussed reversibility as a clue, not the only rule; new substances and evidence were emphasized.
Distinguished melting from dissolving using heating and whether the substance remains present.
Initially treated dissolved sugar as disappeared, then stated that it remains present and contributes mass.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying physical and chemical changes through reversibility, new substances, colour, smell, gas, and light. Ananya explained melting versus dissolving and later corrected the mix-up that dissolved sugar had disappeared, stating that it remains present and contributes mass. At home, ask them to classify two everyday changes and give one piece of evidence for each.

Lekin jali hui baati pehle jaisi nahi ban jaati; aur har physical badlav bhi aasaani se ulta nahi hota, jaise kaagaz phaadna. Ab garmi mein doodh khatta hokar phat jaaye, toh woh physical hai ya chemical badlav, aur kya saboot hai?

haan didi yeh toh chemical hai na... doodh phatne pe woh khatta smell aati hai aur taste bhi badal jaata hai... par mujhe ek baat samajh nahi aayi, agar doodh ko thanda bhi karenge toh wapas doodh nahi ban sakta? matlab yeh irreversible hai isliye chemical?

Haan, doodh ka khatta hona aur smell badalna aapne sahi pakda. Thanda karne se woh pehle jaisa doodh nahi banta, lekin sirf wapas na badal paana chemical change ka pakka saboot nahi hai; phata kaagaz bhi wapas nahi judta, par naya substance nahi banta. Poster kaatne aur sparkler jalne mein chemical change kaunsa hai, aur kyun?

sparkler hi hoga na... kyunki usme aag hai aur light bhi aati hai... poster toh bas kaata hai, woh toh physical hai... par didi reversibility se zyada zaroori matlab? jaise phati poster wapas nahi judti par chemical nahi hai... toh sparkler mein kuch naya banta hai? jaise woh smell? aur aag? kya yeh saboot hai? aur ek baat, aapke paas sparkler ki light ki koi photo hai kya? sparkler dikhao na!

Haan, sparkler jalna chemical aur poster ka katna physical hai. Zyada zaroori sawaal yeh hai ki naya substance bana ya nahi: sparkler mein dhuaan aur raakh bante hain; roshni sanket hai, khud naya substance nahi. Sparkler ki photo abhi nahi dikha sakti; sochiye, jalti teeli se chamakti chingariyan nikal rahi hain. Ab namak paani mein milaane par kya namak pighalta hai ya ghulta hai, aur dono mein kya fark hai?

arey maine toh pehle kabhi socha nahi, namak pighalta hai ya ghulta hai... pighalne mein toh cheez garam karte hain na, jaise ice cream pighalti hai dhoop mein? par namak toh paani mein gayab ho jaata hai, dikhta nahi... par didi, aapke paas ice cream ki photo hai? ice cream dikhao na!

Ice cream ki photo abhi nahi dikha sakti. Sochiye, dhoop mein ice cream ki scoop liquid ban rahi hai: woh pighalna hai. Namak paani mein ghulta hai; dikhta nahi, par paani mein rehta hai. Agar glass ke paani ka wazan tolkar usmein cheeni gholein, toh wazan badhega, utna hi rahega, ya ghatega?

badhega na didi? kyunki cheeni toh daali hai... matlab paani mein gayab ho gayi par wazan toh rehna chahiye... par ek baar maine ek magic trick dekhi thi jisme paani gayab ho gaya tha... aapke paas magic trick ki photo hai? ek aise magic wali photo dikhao!

Aapka guess hai ki cheeni dikhna band ho jaaye, tab bhi uska wazan rehta hai. Magic trick ki photo abhi nahi bana sakti; sochiye, glass mein cheeni ghulkar dikhna band ho gayi, aur paas mein garam chocolate liquid ban gayi. In dono mein kaunsa ghulna hai aur kaunsa pighalna?

chocolate garam karke liquid banana toh pighalna hai na, jaise ice cream... aur sugar paani mein ghuli, toh woh dissolving hai... par sugar ab bhi hai na? dikhti nahi par wazan mein aa jaayegi, jaise aapne abhi kaha... lekin didi, ek baat batao, woh jo aapne number line pe 1/4 dikhane ki baat ki thi, number line pe 1/4 dikhao na!
Aapne cheeni aur chocolate ka fark bataya; ab number line dekhte hain. Board par zero se ek tak chaar barabar hisse hain. Zero ke baad pehla nishaan one fourth hai.

achha toh sugar wala dissolving hai, aur woh ab bhi paani mein hai kyunki uska wazan abhi bhi hai... aur chocolate wala pighalna hai... par didi ek baat, aapne board pe number line dikhaya na, par mujhe woh samajh nahi aaya, aapne likha hai 0 se 1 tak chaar barabar hisse, par kahan? number line pe 1/4 dikhao phir se, pleeease?
Haan, number line par hisse saaf nahi dikh rahe the. Ab board par zero se one tak chaar barabar gaps dekhiye. Zero ke baad pehla nishaan one fourth hai. Kya aapko pehla nishaan dikh raha hai?

haan didi, number line dikh raha hai ab! 0 ke baad pehla nishaan 1/4 hai... samajh gaya. aur question ka answer... hmm... sugar wala dissolving hai, kyunki woh paani mein gayab ho gaya par ab bhi hai, kyunki uska wazan... par wazan toh aapne kaha tha badhega? toh haan sugar ab bhi maujood hai. chocolate wala pighalna hai

Haan, ab aapko number line ka pehla nishaan dikh raha hai. Cheeni ke baare mein bhi aapne kaha ki dikhna band hone par woh paani mein rehti hai. Card ka sawaal ek baar seedha bolti hoon: dono students mein kisne dissolving ki, aur kya cheeni ab bhi drink mein hai?

pehle student ne dissolving kiya... kyunki sugar daali na room-temperature paani mein aur woh gayab ho gayi... aur haan, sugar ab bhi drink mein hai, bina dikhe... kyunki aapne kaha uska wazan rehta hai... par didi, aapke paas chocolate liquid ki photo hai? chocolate dikhao na!

Haan, pehle student ne sugar ghola, aur cheeni dikhna band hone par bhi drink mein hai. Liquid chocolate ki photo abhi nahi dikha sakti. Sochiye, chocolate ka tukda garam hokar behne wala liquid ban gaya; usmein paani milana zaroori nahi.
